thread:
tejas: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we saw the missing spans reappear in the nightly ETL, and aggregation sums are off by ~3% for long-running traces. Capturing action items and owners here so we can close out by EOW.

 maria: Thanks. I can own the sampling policy rollout. Plan: adjust sampler to keep head spans for 10% of traces >50 spans, add guard clause in aggregator to refuse partial prefixes. Target: canary deploy Wed morning.

 samir: Can you also add a regression test for the kv-aggregator? I can add an integration test in analytics-ci and a schema check for dropped-prefixes.

 jordan: FWIW my local profiling suggests tail-sampler is doing the bulk of the drop (it collapses prefixes when we see repeated service hops). I propose a tiny prefix-preservation cache on receiver for the first 1s of a trace.

 ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: linking incident #2345 and postmortem draft https://redwood-incidents/2345/postmortem-draft :bookmark: 

 tejas: @maria +1 for canary. @samir please add perf budget so we don't regress p50/p95. @jordan let's do a quick spike for the prefix cache and run the same trace corpus we used in the postmortem.

 maria: Filed ticket RW-ops/4678 with steps + code pointers. Owner=maria, due=2026-03-27, status=triage. Patch branch: fix/sampler-preserve-head.

 samir: I'll submit PR with integration test and schema validation by EOD tomorrow. Also adding a CI job: analytics-ci/tests/kv-agg-mismatch.

 jordan: did a 10m spike locally — prefix cache reduced missing-span rate from ~2.1% to 0.3% on my sample corpus and added ~2% CPU. Pushing a short design doc and bench numbers: https://gh.redwood/instrumentation/prefix-cache-proposal

 tejas: Good numbers. Can we agree merge window: Wed 09:00-11:00 PST for canary? Also need an alert: analytics.agg.mismatch.rate > 2% for 30m to page oncall. Suggested dashboard panels: agg-error-rate, kv-dropped-prefix, trace-sampling-rate.

 maria: That works. I'll add the alert and the dashboard panels (grafana: /d/obs/agg-integrity) and set canary tag on the dataset.

 samir: tagging oncall — @pager — do we need increased retention for traces during canary? I recommend 72h for traces and raw-span capture for 24h.

 pagerduty-bot: oncall Samira assigned for 2026-03-24T00:00Z to 2026-03-25T00:00Z. Pager duty: notify if analytics.agg.mismatch.rate fires twice in 30m.

 tejas: Action items recap (short):
  1) maria — canary deploy + alert + dashboard (due Wed 09:00 PST)
  2) samir — integration test + perf budget + CI job (EOD tomorrow)
  3) jordan — prefix-cache PR + docs + bench (FRI)
  4) tejas — coordinate canary window, smoke tests, and rollback playbook

 We'll check progress in this thread and do a 15m sync Fri 16:00 PST in #incidents. If any blocker pops up ping @pagerduty-bot and add to the incident ticket RW-ops/4678.

 maria: noted. I updated RW-ops/4678 with a smoke checklist and runbook snippet:

 ```
 # smoke checklist
 - run analytics-ci/kv-agg-mismatch
 - verify dashboard panels show <1% mismatch for 1h
 - confirm retention bump applied for canary traces
 - rollback: revert fix/sampler-preserve-head branch
 ```

 samir: I'll link the integration test in the ticket when PR is up. Thanks all.

 jordan: thanks — will post PR link once ready.

 tejas: thanks team. recording this thread as the canonical follow-up for the postmortem, will link from the postmortem doc and close items as they land. :white_check_mark:
